fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC Havildar Instructor Eligibility Result 2026 – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the Eligibility Result for the recruitment of Havildar Instructor posts on the official website. This recruitment was released for 209 posts. Applications for the UPSSSC Havildar Instructor Recruitment 2026 were accepted from June 19, 2026, to July 09, 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UPSSSC Havildar Instructor Eligibility Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 19 June 2026
  • Last Date : 09 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 09 July 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 16 July 2026
  • Eligibility Result : 30 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 25/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

  • Download Eligibility Result
  • Download Eligibility Result Notice
  • Apply Online

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPSSSC Havildar Instructor Eligibility Result 2026?

UPSSSC Havildar Instructor Eligibility Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
